features.description: Experience a warm and illuminated welcome every time you unlock your car with our new Welcome Lights feature in the MBito app. When you unlock your vehicle in the dark, the low beams will automatically switch on, providing a clear and bright path for 30 seconds. This feature enhances your safety and convenience, making it easier to locate and enter your car at night. With Welcome Lights, you can enjoy a well-lit approach to your Mercedes, adding a touch of sophistication to your driving experience.

multi_feature_definitions.description: Enhance your car's welcoming ambiance with the Blue Welcome Light Extender feature in the MBito app. This function allows you to extend the duration of the blue welcome lights when you unlock your car in the dark. Choose from 10, 15, or 25 seconds to customize the lighting experience to your preference. With the Blue Welcome Light Extender, enjoy a personalized and extended illumination that makes approaching your vehicle at night even more inviting and stylish.
